preconditions.description: The number of rows in the labyrinth is between 1 and 2000.
The number of columns in the labyrinth is between 1 and 2000.
The starting row index is between 1 and n.
The starting column index is between 1 and m.
The maximum allowed number of movements to the left is between 0 and 10^9.
The maximum allowed number of movements to the right is between 0 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: Each labyrinth row is a string of length m consisting of '.' and '*'.
preconditions.description: The labyrinth is described by n rows, each of length m, with '.' indicating a free cell and '*' indicating an obstacle.

preconditions.expression: The starting cell does not contain an obstacle.
preconditions.description: The cell at row r and column c is free.

postconditions.description: The result is the number of cells in the labyrinth that are reachable from the starting cell, including the starting cell itself.
